## 📄 datasheet.js

/**
 * datasheet.js — Generic inline-edit datasheet engine for Curator
 *
 * Behaviour:
 *   - Click any editable cell → row enters edit mode
 *   - All exits from a dirty row → Save/Discard dialog
 *   - Clean row exits → silent, no dialog
 *   - One row in edit mode at a time
 *   - Tab moves between editable cells within the row
 *   - Escape → dialog (if dirty)
 *   - ⋯ detail button is ignored by edit machinery
 *
 * Column definitions are read from data attributes on <th> elements:
 *   data-field="name"      — field name, matched to td[data-field]
 *   data-type="text"       — input type: text | select
 *
 * Row data is read from data attributes on <tr> elements:
 *   data-id="123"          — record ID, used in save URL
 *
 * Cell display vs stored value:
 *   For select cells, td[data-value] holds the ID, text content is the label.
 *   For text cells, text content is both display and value.
 *
 * Save endpoint:
 *   POST /crew/projects/{id}/save  (JSON body)
 *   Response: updated <tr> HTML to swap in
 *
 * Add endpoint:
 *   POST /crew/projects/save  (JSON body, no ID)
 *   Response: new <tr> HTML to prepend
 */

(function () {
    'use strict';

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // State
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    let activeRow = null;       // the <tr> currently in edit mode
    let originalValues = null;  // snapshot of values before editing
    let isDirty = false;        // has anything changed?
    let pendingAction = null;   // action to run after dialog resolves

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Dialog
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function getDialog() {
        return document.getElementById('datasheet-dialog');
    }

    function showDialog(onSave, onDiscard) {
        pendingAction = { onSave, onDiscard };
        getDialog().showModal();
    }

    function initDialog() {
        const dialog = document.getElementById('datasheet-dialog');
        if (!dialog) return;

        dialog.querySelector('.ds-dialog-save').addEventListener('click', () => {
            dialog.close();
            if (pendingAction) pendingAction.onSave();
            pendingAction = null;
        });

        dialog.querySelector('.ds-dialog-discard').addEventListener('click', () => {
            dialog.close();
            if (pendingAction) pendingAction.onDiscard();
            pendingAction = null;
        });

        // Click backdrop to dismiss = discard
        dialog.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === dialog) {
                dialog.close();
                if (pendingAction) pendingAction.onDiscard();
                pendingAction = null;
            }
        });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Column definitions — read from <th data-field data-type>
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function getColumns(table) {
        const cols = [];
        table.querySelectorAll('thead th[data-field]').forEach(th => {
            cols.push({
                field: th.dataset.field,
                type: th.dataset.type || 'text',
            });
        });
        return cols;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Lookup data — read from window.projectTypes / window.projectStatuses
    // Keyed by field name for generic access
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function getOptions(field) {
        if (field === 'type_id')   return window.projectTypes   || [];
        if (field === 'status_id') return window.projectStatuses || [];
        return [];
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Snapshot — capture current cell values before editing
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function snapshot(row, cols) {
        const values = {};
        cols.forEach(col => {
            const td = row.querySelector(`td[data-field="${col.field}"]`);
            if (!td) return;
            values[col.field] = col.type === 'select'
                ? (td.dataset.value || '')
                : td.textContent.trim();
        });
        return values;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Dirty check — compare current inputs to snapshot
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function checkDirty(row, cols) {
        if (!originalValues) return false;
        return cols.some(col => {
            const input = row.querySelector(`[data-field="${col.field}"] input, [data-field="${col.field}"] select`);
            if (!input) return false;
            return String(input.value) !== String(originalValues[col.field] || '');
        });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Enter edit mode — replace cell text with inputs
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function enterEditMode(row, cols, focusField) {
        if (activeRow === row) return;

        row.classList.add('ds-editing');
        originalValues = snapshot(row, cols);
        isDirty = false;

        cols.forEach(col => {
            const td = row.querySelector(`td[data-field="${col.field}"]`);
            if (!td) return;

            const currentValue = originalValues[col.field];
            const displayText = td.textContent.trim();

            if (col.type === 'select') {
                const options = getOptions(col.field);
                const sel = document.createElement('select');
                sel.className = 'ds-select';
                sel.dataset.field = col.field;

                // Blank option
                const blank = document.createElement('option');
                blank.value = '';
                blank.textContent = '— select —';
                sel.appendChild(blank);

                options.forEach(opt => {
                    const o = document.createElement('option');
                    o.value = opt.id;
                    o.textContent = opt.name;
                    if (String(opt.id) === String(currentValue)) o.selected = true;
                    sel.appendChild(o);
                });

                sel.addEventListener('change', () => { isDirty = checkDirty(row, cols); });
                td.dataset.originalText = displayText;
                td.textContent = '';
                td.appendChild(sel);

            } else {
                const input = document.createElement('input');
                input.type = 'text';
                input.className = 'ds-input';
                input.dataset.field = col.field;
                input.value = currentValue === '—' ? '' : currentValue;

                input.addEventListener('input', () => { isDirty = checkDirty(row, cols); });
                td.dataset.originalText = displayText;
                td.textContent = '';
                td.appendChild(input);
            }
        });

        activeRow = row;

        // Focus the clicked field or first editable field
        const focusTarget = focusField
            ? row.querySelector(`td[data-field="${focusField}"] input, td[data-field="${focusField}"] select`)
            : row.querySelector('.ds-input, .ds-select');
        if (focusTarget) focusTarget.focus();
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Exit edit mode — restore cell text from saved/discarded values
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function exitEditMode(row, cols, newValues) {
        cols.forEach(col => {
            const td = row.querySelector(`td[data-field="${col.field}"]`);
            if (!td) return;

            const input = td.querySelector('input, select');
            if (!input) return;

            if (newValues) {
                // Update display from saved values
                if (col.type === 'select') {
                    const options = getOptions(col.field);
                    const match = options.find(o => String(o.id) === String(newValues[col.field]));
                    td.textContent = match ? match.name : '—';
                    td.dataset.value = newValues[col.field] || '';
                } else {
                    td.textContent = newValues[col.field] || '—';
                }
            } else {
                // Restore original display
                td.textContent = td.dataset.originalText || '—';
                if (col.type === 'select') {
                    td.dataset.value = originalValues[col.field] || '';
                }
            }
        });

        row.classList.remove('ds-editing');
        activeRow = null;
        originalValues = null;
        isDirty = false;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Save row — POST to server, update display from response
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async function saveRow(row, cols, table) {
        const id = row.dataset.id;
        const isNew = row.dataset.new === 'true';
        const role = table.dataset.role || '';

        const body = {};
        cols.forEach(col => {
            const input = row.querySelector(`td[data-field="${col.field}"] input, td[data-field="${col.field}"] select`);
            if (input) body[col.field] = input.value;
        });

        const url = isNew
            ? `/crew/projects/save?role=${role}`
            : `/crew/projects/${id}/save`;

        try {
            const resp = await fetch(url, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                body: JSON.stringify(body),
            });

            if (!resp.ok) {
                const err = await resp.text();
                showError(row, err);
                return false;
            }

            // Server returns updated row HTML
            const html = await resp.text();
            const tmp = document.createElement('tbody');
            tmp.innerHTML = html;
            const newRow = tmp.querySelector('tr');

            if (newRow) {
                // Re-attach click handlers before swapping in
                attachRowHandlers(newRow, cols, table);
                row.replaceWith(newRow);
            }

            activeRow = null;
            originalValues = null;
            isDirty = false;
            return true;

        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Save failed:', err);
            return false;
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Add new row — insert empty editable row at top of tbody
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function insertNewRow(table, cols) {
        const tbody = table.querySelector('tbody');
        const role = table.dataset.role || '';

        const row = document.createElement('tr');
        row.classList.add('ds-editing', 'ds-new');
        row.dataset.new = 'true';
        row.dataset.id = '';

        // Icon column
        const iconTd = document.createElement('td');
        iconTd.className = 'icon-col';
        const detailBtn = document.createElement('button');
        detailBtn.className = 'detail-icon';
        detailBtn.textContent = '⋯';
        detailBtn.disabled = true;
        iconTd.appendChild(detailBtn);
        row.appendChild(iconTd);

        // Editable cells
        cols.forEach(col => {
            const td = document.createElement('td');
            td.dataset.field = col.field;

            if (col.type === 'select') {
                const options = getOptions(col.field);
                const sel = document.createElement('select');
                sel.className = 'ds-select';
                sel.dataset.field = col.field;

                const blank = document.createElement('option');
                blank.value = '';
                blank.textContent = '— select —';
                sel.appendChild(blank);

                options.forEach(opt => {
                    const o = document.createElement('option');
                    o.value = opt.id;
                    o.textContent = opt.name;
                    sel.appendChild(o);
                });

                sel.addEventListener('change', () => { isDirty = true; });
                td.appendChild(sel);
            } else {
                const input = document.createElement('input');
                input.type = 'text';
                input.className = 'ds-input';
                input.dataset.field = col.field;
                input.placeholder = col.field === 'name' ? 'Project name' : '';
                input.addEventListener('input', () => { isDirty = true; });
                td.appendChild(input);
            }

            row.appendChild(td);
        });

        tbody.insertBefore(row, tbody.firstChild);
        activeRow = row;
        originalValues = {};
        isDirty = false;

        // Focus first input
        const first = row.querySelector('.ds-input, .ds-select');
        if (first) first.focus();
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Error display
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function showError(row, message) {
        let err = row.querySelector('.ds-error');
        if (!err) {
            err = document.createElement('span');
            err.className = 'ds-error';
            const firstTd = row.querySelector('td:not(.icon-col)');
            if (firstTd) firstTd.appendChild(err);
        }
        err.textContent = message;
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Tab handling within a row
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function handleTab(e, row) {
        if (e.key !== 'Tab') return;
        const inputs = [...row.querySelectorAll('.ds-input, .ds-select')];
        if (!inputs.length) return;

        const current = document.activeElement;
        const idx = inputs.indexOf(current);

        if (!e.shiftKey && idx === inputs.length - 1) {
            e.preventDefault(); // Tab on last field — stay in row
        } else if (e.shiftKey && idx === 0) {
            e.preventDefault(); // Shift-Tab on first field — stay in row
        }
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Attempt to leave active row — dirty check gate
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function attemptLeave(cols, table, onProceed) {
        if (!activeRow) {
            onProceed();
            return;
        }

        isDirty = checkDirty(activeRow, cols);

        if (!isDirty) {
            // New unsaved row — just remove it cleanly
            if (activeRow.dataset.new === 'true') {
                activeRow.remove();
                activeRow = null;
                originalValues = null;
            } else {
                exitEditMode(activeRow, cols, null);
            }
            onProceed();
            return;
        }

        // Dirty — show dialog
        showDialog(
            // Save
            async () => {
                const saved = await saveRow(activeRow, cols, table);
                if (saved) onProceed();
            },
            // Discard
            () => {
                if (activeRow) {
                    if (activeRow.dataset.new === 'true') {
                        activeRow.remove();
                    } else {
                        exitEditMode(activeRow, cols, null);
                    }
                    activeRow = null;
                    originalValues = null;
                    isDirty = false;
                }
                onProceed();
            }
        );
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Attach handlers to a single display row
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function attachRowHandlers(row, cols, table) {
        // Click any editable cell
        cols.forEach(col => {
            const td = row.querySelector(`td[data-field="${col.field}"]`);
            if (!td) return;

            td.style.cursor = 'text';
            td.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (activeRow === row) return; // already editing this row

                attemptLeave(cols, table, () => {
                    enterEditMode(row, cols, col.field);
                });
            });
        });

        // Keyboard handlers while row is active
        row.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (activeRow !== row) return;

            handleTab(e, row);

            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                isDirty = checkDirty(row, cols);
                attemptLeave(cols, table, () => {});
            }
        });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Init a single datasheet table
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function initTable(table) {
        const cols = getColumns(table);
        if (!cols.length) return;

        // Attach handlers to existing display rows
        table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr:not(.ds-editing)').forEach(row => {
            if (row.dataset.id) attachRowHandlers(row, cols, table);
        });

        // + button
        const addBtn = table.querySelector('.add-icon');
        if (addBtn) {
            addBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                attemptLeave(cols, table, () => {
                    insertNewRow(table, cols);
                });
            });
        }

        // Click outside table — dirty check
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!activeRow) return;
            if (table.contains(e.target)) return;
            if (getDialog().contains(e.target)) return;

            isDirty = checkDirty(activeRow, cols);
            attemptLeave(cols, table, () => {});
        });
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Public init — call on DOMContentLoaded
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    function init() {
        initDialog();
        document.querySelectorAll('table.crew-table[data-datasheet]').forEach(initTable);
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);

    // Re-init after HTMX swaps (search results replace tbody)
    document.addEventListener('htmx:afterSwap', (e) => {
        const table = e.target.closest('table.crew-table[data-datasheet]');
        if (!table) return;
        const cols = getColumns(table);
        table.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach(row => {
            if (row.dataset.id && !row._dsAttached) {
                attachRowHandlers(row, cols, table);
                row._dsAttached = true;
            }
        });
    });

})();

## BEFORE (line 19-68)

```python
@router.get("/crew", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def crew_dashboard(
    role: str = Query("captain"),
    config: ConfigManager = Depends(get_config),
    db: AsyncDBConnection = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Crew dashboard — displays projects filtered by crew role.

    Query parameters:
        role: One of the roles defined in curator.yaml

    Queries the role-specific PostgreSQL view (e.g. projects.scribe_view)
    and passes results to the crew.html template.
    """
    crew_roles = config.get("crew", "roles")
    valid_roles = [r["name"] for r in crew_roles]

    if role not in valid_roles:
        role = "captain"  # Safe fallback

    # Find the role's metadata
    role_meta = next((r for r in crew_roles if r["name"] == role), None)

    # Query the role-specific view — role is validated above, safe to interpolate
    view_name = f"projects.{role}_view"
    sql = f"""
        SELECT
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.slug,
            p.description,
            ps.name  AS status,
            pt.name  AS type
        FROM {view_name} p
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_status ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_type   pt ON pt.id = p.type_id
        ORDER BY p.name
    """
    records = await db.fetch_all(sql)

    template = env.get_template("crew.html")

    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": records,
    }

@router.get("/crew", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def crew_dashboard(
    role: str = Query("captain"),
    search: str = Query(""),
    config: ConfigManager = Depends(get_config),
    db: AsyncDBConnection = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Crew dashboard — displays projects filtered by crew role and search term.

    Query parameters:
        role: One of the roles defined in curator.yaml
        search: Optional search term to filter projects by name

    Queries the role-specific PostgreSQL view, filters by search,
    and passes lookup tables for inline edit forms.
    """
    crew_roles = config.get("crew", "roles")
    valid_roles = [r["name"] for r in crew_roles]

    if role not in valid_roles:
        role = "captain"  # Safe fallback

    # Find the role's metadata
    role_meta = next((r for r in crew_roles if r["name"] == role), None)

    # Query the role-specific view — role is validated above, safe to interpolate
    view_name = f"projects.{role}_view"
    sql = f"""
        SELECT
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.slug,
            p.description,
            p.status_id,
            ps.name  AS status,
            p.type_id,
            pt.name  AS type
        FROM {view_name} p
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_status ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_type   pt ON pt.id = p.type_id
    """
    
    params = {}
    if search:
        sql += " WHERE LOWER(p.name) LIKE LOWER(:search)"
        params["search"] = f"%{search}%"
    
    sql += " ORDER BY p.name"
    records = await db.fetch_all(sql, params)

    # Fetch lookup tables for inline edit forms
    project_types = await db.fetch_all(
        "SELECT id, name FROM projects.project_type ORDER BY name"
    )
    project_statuses = await db.fetch_all(
        "SELECT id, name FROM projects.project_status ORDER BY name"
    )

    template = env.get_template("crew.html")

    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": [dict(r) for r in records],
        "project_types": [dict(pt) for pt in project_types],
        "project_statuses": [dict(ps) for ps in project_statuses],
        "search": search,
    }

    return template.render(**data)
```

## AFTER

```python
"""Crew role dashboard routes."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, Depends
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader
from pathlib import Path

from dbkit.connection import AsyncDBConnection
from curator.config import ConfigManager
from curator.web.deps import get_config, get_db

router = APIRouter()

# Initialize Jinja2 for crew dashboard
TEMPLATES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "templates"
env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(TEMPLATES_DIR))


@router.get("/crew", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def crew_dashboard(
    role: str = Query("captain"),
    search: str = Query("", alias="search"),
    config: ConfigManager = Depends(get_config),
    db: AsyncDBConnection = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Crew dashboard — displays projects filtered by crew role and search term.

    Query parameters:
        role: One of the roles defined in curator.yaml
        search: Optional search term to filter projects by name

    Returns the projects.{role}_view filtered by search, plus lookup tables
    for inline edit forms (project types, project statuses).
    """
    crew_roles = config.get("crew", "roles")
    valid_roles = [r["name"] for r in crew_roles]
    
    if role not in valid_roles:
        role = "captain"  # Safe fallback
    
    # Find the role's metadata
    role_meta = next((r for r in crew_roles if r["name"] == role), None)
    
    # Query the role-specific view — role is validated above, safe to interpolate
    view_name = f"projects.{role}_view"
    sql = f"""
        SELECT
            id,
            name,
            description,
            status_id,
            status,
            type_id,
            type
        FROM {view_name}
    """
    
    params = {}
    if search:
        sql += " WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE LOWER(:search)"
        params["search"] = f"%{search}%"
    
    sql += " ORDER BY name"
    records = await db.fetch_all(sql, params)
    
    # Fetch lookup tables for inline edit forms
    project_types = await db.fetch_all(
        "SELECT id, name FROM projects.project_type ORDER BY name"
    )
    project_statuses = await db.fetch_all(
        "SELECT id, name FROM projects.project_status ORDER BY name"
    )
    
    template = env.get_template("crew.html")
    
    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": [dict(r) for r in records],
        "project_types": [dict(pt) for pt in project_types],
        "project_statuses": [dict(ps) for ps in project_statuses],
        "search": search,
    }
    
    return template.render(**data)
```

---

## What Changed

1. **Added imports**: `AsyncDBConnection` from dbkit, `get_db` from deps
2. **Added `search` parameter** to handle filter input from _projects_table.html
3. **Query the role view** (`projects.{role}_view`) instead of returning empty records
4. **Filter by search term** if provided (case-insensitive LIKE on name)
5. **Fetch lookup tables** from `projects.project_type` and `projects.project_status`
6. **Convert rows to dicts** before passing to template (Jinja2 needs dicts, not Row objects)
7. **Pass all data** including `project_types`, `project_statuses`, and `search` value to template

---

## Why This Works

- The captain.html template expects `project_types` and `project_statuses` in the script block to be available as `window.projectTypes` and `window.projectStatuses` (see `| tojson` filter)
- The _crew_row_add.html and _crew_row_edit.html partials use these globals to populate the type/status dropdowns
- The search box in _projects_table.html makes an HTMX GET request to `/crew` with the search term, this route handles it

                                <td>{{ contact.email or "—" }}</td>

                        </tbody>

                        <p>No contacts found.</p>

                                        class="add-icon"
                                        hx-get="/crew/identities/organizations/new?role={{ role }}"
                                        hx-target="#organizations-rows"
                                        hx-swap="afterbegin"
                                        title="Add organization"

                                    Name

                                <th>Type</th>
                                <th>Website</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="organizations-rows">
                            {% for org in organizations %}
                            <tr class="organization-row" id="display-row-org-{{ org.id }}">
                                <td class="icon-col">
                                    <button class="edit-icon" 
                                            hx-get="/crew/identities/organizations/{{ org.id }}/edit-form" 
                                            hx-target="#display-row-org-{{ org.id }}" 
                                            hx-swap="outerHTML"
                                            title="Edit">✏️</button>
                                    <button class="detail-icon" title="Details" disabled>⋯</button>
                                </td>
                                <td>{{ org.name }}</td>
                                <td>{{ org.type or "—" }}</td>
                                <td>{{ org.website or "—" }}</td>
                            </tr>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                {% else %}
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <p>No organizations found.</p>
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>

            <!-- Users / DB Auth Sub-view -->
            <div id="selector-users" class="selector-panel">
                {% if users %}
                    <table class="crew-table">

                                <th class="icon-col"></th>

                                <td class="icon-col">
                                    <button class="edit-icon" 
                                            hx-get="/crew/identities/users/{{ user.id }}/edit-form" 
                                            hx-target="#display-row-user-{{ user.id }}"

                                    <button class="detail-icon" title="Details" disabled>⋯</button>
                                </td>

                                <td>{{ user.email or "—" }}</td>
                                <td>{{ user.role or "—" }}</td>

                {% else %}

                        <p>No users found.</p>
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Configuration Tab -->
    <div id="tab-configuration" class="tab-panel">
        <div class="crew-content">
            <div class="empty-state">
                <p>Configuration options coming soon.</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<!-- Embed lookups as data for access in partials -->
<script>
    window.projectTypes = {{ project_types | tojson }};
    window.projectStatuses = {{ project_statuses | tojson }};

    // Main tab switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const tabId = this.dataset.tab;
            
            // Hide all tabs, remove active class from all buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(panel => {
                panel.classList.remove('active');
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(button => {
                button.classList.remove('active');
            });
            
            // Show selected tab, add active class to clicked button
            document.getElementById(tabId).classList.add('active');
            this.classList.add('active');
        });
    });

    // Identities sub-selector switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.selector-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            const selectorId = 'selector-' + this.dataset.selector;
            
            // Hide all selector panels, remove active class from all buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.selector-panel').forEach(panel => {
                panel.classList.remove('active');
            });
            document.querySelectorAll('.selector-btn').forEach(button => {
                button.classList.remove('active');
            });
            
            // Show selected panel, add active class to clicked button
            document.getElementById(selectorId).classList.add('active');
            this.classList.add('active');
        });
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

## 📄 captain_projects_dry_refactor

# Captain's Projects Tab — DRY Refactor

## Goal

Extract the shared projects table (search box + table structure) into a single
reusable partial so both `crew.html` (other roles) and `captain.html` (Captain's
Projects tab) use the same source. Change the layout once, and every role updates.

Also fixes: colorful pencil emoji everywhere, no icon backgrounds on Captain's
page (by using the `crew-table` class that forms.css targets), and matching row
heights across all forms.

---

## Partial Hierarchy

```
_projects_table.html   ← NEW: search box + table shell (the reusable piece)
  └── _crew_rows.html        ← existing: the {% for record %} loop
        └── _crew_row_display.html   ← existing: one display row
```

`crew.html` and `captain.html` both include `_projects_table.html`.

---

## File Changes Summary

| File | Action | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `templates/_projects_table.html` | Create | Shared search + table shell |
| `templates/crew.html` | Modify | Replace inline table with include |
| `templates/captain.html` | Modify | Replace Projects tab inline table with include; fix script vars |
| `templates/_crew_row_display.html` | Modify | Colorful pencil emoji (✏ → ✏️) |

---

## 1. Create `src/curator/templates/_projects_table.html`

This is the shared piece — the search box and table that both crew.html and
captain.html were duplicating.

```html

        placeholder="Search projects..."
        value="{{ search }}"
        hx-get="/crew"

        hx-target="#crew-rows"
        hx-include="[name='search']"
        hx-vals='{"role": "{{ role }}"}'
    >

    <table class="crew-table">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th class="icon-col"></th>
                <th>
                    <button
                        class="add-icon"
                        hx-get="/crew/projects/new?role={{ role }}"
                        hx-target="#crew-rows"
                        hx-swap="afterbegin"
                        title="Add project"
                    >+</button>
                    Name
                </th>
                <th>Type</th>
                <th>Status</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="crew-rows">
            {% include "_crew_rows.html" %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
```

## 4. Modify `src/curator/templates/_crew_row_display.html`

Use the colorful pencil emoji (with variation selector) instead of the plain one.

## Why This Is Better (DRY)

**Before:** The search box and table markup lived in two places — crew.html and
captain.html — and they had drifted (different class names, different icon
emoji, different search wiring). That drift is exactly what caused the
background/row-height/icon inconsistencies.

**After:** One source of truth — `_projects_table.html`. Both templates include
it. Change the layout once and every role (plus Captain's Projects tab) updates
together. No drift possible.

**The nesting also stays DRY:**
```
_projects_table.html   (search + table shell)
  └── _crew_rows.html        (the loop)
        └── _crew_row_display.html   (one row, with the colorful pencil)
```

Each layer is independently reusable.

## 📄 qt_customer_app_design_notes

# Qt Customer App — Design Notes
## Refurb Customer Portal Companion

---

## Concept

A Qt desktop application shipped as part of the refurb package to every
customer. Cross-platform: develop on Linux, build Windows .exe, Mac if
patience holds.

Primary purpose: **one-click remote support access**, customer-initiated,
time-bounded, cryptographically secure.

---

## Remote Support Flow

```
Customer clicks "Request Support"
    → Qt app requests time-limited authkey from headscale server
    → authkey encrypted + signed with GPG, sent to Carolyn over mesh
    → Carolyn receives authkey, customer machine joins mesh temporarily
    → Remote session proceeds (NX/SPICE/RDP depending on platform)
    → Authkey expires, machine leaves mesh automatically
```

**Why this is elegant:**
- No VPN setup for the customer
- No port forwarding, no "tell me your IP address"
- No permanent mesh membership — time-bounded only
- Customer-initiated — they clicked the button, they stay in control
- Authkey expiry means access ends automatically even if Carolyn forgets
  to disconnect

---

## GPG Role

GPG handles security transparently — customer never touches it directly.

**At onboarding (provisioned by curator_init.py or equivalent):**
- Customer GPG keypair generated and stored in Qt app config
- Carolyn's public GPG key pre-installed in the app
- App is pre-configured — customer never runs gpg commands

**During support request:**
- Authkey request encrypted with Carolyn's public key (only she can read it)
- Request signed with customer's private key (proves it's really them)
- Carolyn's tooling decrypts and verifies automatically

**Proven pattern:**
GPG used successfully in Proxmox API app — passphrase entered once at
app start, then completely transparent. Same pattern applies here.
Customer experience: click button, support session starts. GPG invisible.

---

## Qt App UI (sketch)

**Main window — minimal:**
```
┌─────────────────────────────────┐
│  [Logo]  WCYJ Tech Support      │
│                                 │
│  Your devices: 2                │
│  Open tickets: 1                │
│                                 │
│  ┌─────────────────────────┐   │
│  │   Request Support       │   │
│  └─────────────────────────┘   │
│                                 │
│  Status: No active session      │
└─────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Status indicators:**
- `No active session` — idle
- `Requesting session...` — authkey being requested
- `Support session active` — mesh connected, Carolyn is in
- `Session ended` — authkey expired or closed

**Optional: portal link**
- Button to open Curator customer portal in browser
- Shows their devices, tickets, work history

---

## Observatory Integration

Active support sessions visible on the star map:

```
● Gray   — customer machine, no active session
● Amber  — support session requested, not yet connected
● Green  — support session active
● Gray   — session expired/closed
```

Clicking the star in Observatory → opens session details or connects
directly.

---

## Headscale Integration

- App holds pre-provisioned headscale node identity (set up at onboarding)
- On support request: calls headscale API for time-limited authkey
- Authkey duration: configurable (default 1 hour)
- On expiry: node automatically deregisters from mesh
- Customer machine is never a permanent mesh node

**Authkey transmission:**
- Encrypted to Carolyn's GPG key → only she can decrypt
- Signed by customer's GPG key → she can verify the source
- Sent via mesh or fallback to encrypted email if mesh not yet active

---

## Curator Integration

Customer portal (scoped Curator view):
- Customer logs in → sees only their own records
- Their devices (from `infrastructure` schema)
- Their tickets/projects (from `projects` schema, filtered by contact)
- Work history and notes
- Maybe: discussion thread per ticket

**Database scope:**
- `identity.contacts` — customer record
- `identity.app_user` — portal login (customer role)
- `projects.projects` filtered by customer contact
- `infrastructure` filtered by customer's devices

**Felipe's scoped access** (already in roadmap):
- Herald mesh node
- `refurb` PostgreSQL role limiting to refurb records only
- Same pattern extends to all refurb customers

---

## Onboarding Package

When customer picks up their refurbed machine:

1. Qt app pre-installed and pre-configured
2. GPG keypair already generated (by onboarding script)
3. Carolyn's public key pre-installed
4. Headscale node identity provisioned
5. Portal login credentials in a GPG-signed welcome email
6. One-page printed instructions: "Click this button if you need help"

Customer effort: zero cryptography, zero configuration.

---

## Build Plan

**Phase 1 — Linux (develop here first):**
- Qt6 + Python (PyQt6) or C++ Qt
- GPG via python-gnupg or subprocess
- Headscale API calls via requests/httpx
- Single window, minimal UI

**Phase 2 — Windows .exe:**
- PyInstaller or cx_Freeze if Python
- Qt installer framework if C++
- GPG bundled (Gpg4win or similar)
- Code signing certificate eventually

**Phase 3 — Mac (if patience holds):**
- Same codebase, different build target
- GPG via GPG Suite or bundled
- App notarization required for distribution

---

## Related Projects

- **Curator** — customer portal backend and UI
- **Headscale** — mesh coordination server at jump.whycantyoujust.tech
- **Observatory** — star map showing active support sessions
- **curator_init.py** — customer onboarding script (provisions keys,
  mesh identity, portal account, sends welcome email)
- **Bosun** (future) — git operations, may overlap with some tooling

---

## Key Design Principles

1. **Customer-initiated** — support access only when customer clicks
   the button. No persistent access, no background agents phoning home.

2. **Time-bounded** — authkey expires automatically. No cleanup required.

3. **GPG invisible** — cryptography happens in the background.
   Customer experience is: click button, get help.

4. **Zero configuration** — everything pre-provisioned at onboarding.
   Customer receives a working app, not a setup wizard.

5. **Cross-platform** — Qt chosen specifically for write-once,
   build-for-each-platform capability.

## 📄 captain_projects_dry_refactor

# Captain's Projects Tab — DRY Refactor

## Goal

Extract the shared projects table (search box + table structure) into a single
reusable partial so both `crew.html` (other roles) and `captain.html` (Captain's
Projects tab) use the same source. Change the layout once, and every role updates.

Also fixes: colorful pencil emoji everywhere, no icon backgrounds on Captain's
page (by using the `crew-table` class that forms.css targets), and matching row
heights across all forms.

---

## Partial Hierarchy

```
_projects_table.html   ← NEW: search box + table shell (the reusable piece)
  └── _crew_rows.html        ← existing: the {% for record %} loop
        └── _crew_row_display.html   ← existing: one display row
```

`crew.html` and `captain.html` both include `_projects_table.html`.

---

## File Changes Summary

| File | Action | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `templates/_projects_table.html` | Create | Shared search + table shell |
| `templates/crew.html` | Modify | Replace inline table with include |
| `templates/captain.html` | Modify | Replace Projects tab inline table with include; fix script vars |
| `templates/_crew_row_display.html` | Modify | Colorful pencil emoji (✏ → ✏️) |

---

## 1. Create `src/curator/templates/_projects_table.html`

This is the shared piece — the search box and table that both crew.html and
captain.html were duplicating.

```html
<div class="crew-content">
    <input
        type="search"
        name="search"
        placeholder="Search projects..."
        value="{{ search }}"
        hx-get="/crew"
        hx-trigger="keyup changed delay:300ms"
        hx-target="#crew-rows"
        hx-include="[name='search']"
        hx-vals='{"role": "{{ role }}"}'
    >

    <table class="crew-table">
        <thead>
            <tr>
                <th class="icon-col"></th>
                <th>
                    <button
                        class="add-icon"
                        hx-get="/crew/projects/new?role={{ role }}"
                        hx-target="#crew-rows"
                        hx-swap="afterbegin"
                        title="Add project"
                    >+</button>
                    Name
                </th>
                <th>Type</th>
                <th>Status</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="crew-rows">
            {% include "_crew_rows.html" %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
```

## 📄 dark_css_fixed.css

/* =============================================================================
   Dark Theme
   Overrides light.css variables for dark mode readability
   ============================================================================= */

:root {
    /* App shell — dark backgrounds, light text */
    --color-primary:      #0f766e;  /* teal stays same for accent */
    --color-primary-dark: #0d6460;
    --color-primary-light:#20b2aa;  /* Lighter teal for dark theme contrast */

    /* Neutrals — inverted */
    --color-bg:           #1a1a1a;
    --color-surface:      #2a2a2a;
    --color-border:       #404040;
    --color-text:         #e5e5e5;
    --color-text-light:   #a0a0a0;

    /* Semantic */
    --color-danger:       #dc2626;
    --color-danger-bg:    #3a1a1a;
    --color-success:      #166534;
    --color-warning:      #b45309;
}

body {
    background: var(--color-bg);
    color: var(--color-text);
}

/* -- Navbar ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

.navbar {
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
}

.nav-brand a {
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

.nav-links a {
    color: var(--color-text-light);
}

.nav-links a:hover {
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* -- Footer ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

footer {
    color: var(--color-text-light);
    border-top-color: var(--color-border);
}

/* -- Links ----------------------------------------------------------------- */

a {
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

a:hover {
    color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

/* -- Landing page specific ------------------------------------------------- */

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    color: var(--color-text);
}

.subtitle {
    color: var(--color-text-light);
}

## 📄 tabs_css_fixed.css

/* =============================================================================
   Tab Navigation — Main tabs
   ============================================================================= */

.tab-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border);
    margin: 1.5rem 0 1.5rem 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.tab-btn {
    padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-light);
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.tab-btn:hover {
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

.tab-btn.active {
    border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    font-weight: 600;
}

/* =============================================================================
   Tab Panels
   ============================================================================= */

.tab-panels {
    display: block;
}

.tab-panel {
    display: none;
}

.tab-panel.active {
    display: block;
    animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease;
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
    }
    to {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

/* =============================================================================
   Sub-tab Navigation — Within Identities tab
   ============================================================================= */

.sub-tab-bar {
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    margin: 1.5rem 0 1.5rem 0;
    padding: 0;
}

.sub-tab-btn {
    padding: 0.5rem 1rem;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    color: var(--color-text-light);
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.sub-tab-btn:hover {
    color: var(--color-primary);
}

.sub-tab-btn.active {
    border-bottom-color: var(--color-primary);
    color: var(--color-primary);
    font-weight: 600;
}

/* =============================================================================
   Sub-tab Panels
   ============================================================================= */

.sub-tab-panels {
    display: block;
}

.sub-tab-panel {
    display: none;
}

.sub-tab-panel.active {
    display: block;
    animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease;
}

/* =============================================================================
   Placeholder Styling
   ============================================================================= */

.sub-form-placeholder {
    padding: 2rem;
    background: var(--color-surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    border-radius: 0.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 1.5rem;
}

.sub-form-placeholder p {
    margin: 0.5rem 0;
    color: var(--color-text);
}

.sub-form-placeholder .hint {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    color: var(--color-text-light);
}

/* =============================================================================
   Responsive
   ============================================================================= */

@media (max-width: 640px) {
    .tab-bar,
    .sub-tab-bar {
        gap: 0.25rem;
    }

    .tab-btn,
    .sub-tab-btn {
        padding-left: 1rem;
        padding-right: 1rem;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
    }
}

## 📄 captain_html_fixed.html

{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Captain's Command — Curator{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<section class="crew-section">
    <div class="crew-header">
        <img src="/static/img/captain.png" alt="Captain" class="crew-hero-image">
        <h1>{{ role_title }}</h1>
        <a href="/" class="btn-back">← Back to Crew</a>
    </div>

    <!-- Main Tab Navigation -->
    <div class="tab-bar">
        <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="projects">Projects</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="identities">Identities</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="configuration">Configuration</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Main Tab Panels -->
    <div class="tab-panels">
        <!-- Projects Tab -->
        <div id="tab-projects" class="tab-panel active">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <div style="margin-bottom: 1.5rem;">
                    <input type="text" id="search-input" placeholder="Search projects..." 
                           hx-get="/crew" 
                           hx-target="#crew-rows" 
                           hx-include="[name='role']"
                           hx-trigger="input changed delay:300ms"
                           value="{{ search }}"
                           style="width: 100%;">
                    <input type="hidden" name="role" value="{{ role }}">
                </div>

                {% if records %}
                    <table class="records-table">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th></th>
                                <th>Name
                                    <button class="add-icon" 
                                            hx-get="/crew/projects/new?role={{ role }}" 
                                            hx-target="#crew-rows" 
                                            hx-swap="afterbegin"
                                            title="Add project">+</button>
                                </th>
                                <th>Type</th>
                                <th>Status</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="crew-rows">
                            {% for record in records %}
                            <tr class="project-row" id="display-row-{{ record['id'] }}">
                                <td class="icon-col">
                                    <button class="edit-icon" 
                                            hx-get="/crew/projects/{{ record['id'] }}/edit-form" 
                                            hx-target="#display-row-{{ record['id'] }}" 
                                            hx-swap="outerHTML"
                                            title="Edit">✏️</button>
                                    <button class="detail-icon" title="Details" disabled>⋯</button>
                                </td>
                                <td>{{ record["name"] }}</td>
                                <td>{{ record["type"] or "—" }}</td>
                                <td>{{ record["status"] }}</td>
                            </tr>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                {% else %}
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <p>No projects found.</p>
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Identities Tab -->
        <div id="tab-identities" class="tab-panel">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <!-- Identities Sub-selector -->
                <div class="sub-tab-bar">
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn active" data-sub="contacts">Contacts</button>
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn" data-sub="organizations">Organizations</button>
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn" data-sub="users">Users (DB Auth)</button>
                </div>

                <!-- Identities Sub-panels -->
                <div class="sub-tab-panels">
                    <!-- Contacts Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-contacts" class="sub-tab-panel active">
                        {% include "_identities_contacts.html" %}
                    </div>

                    <!-- Organizations Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-organizations" class="sub-tab-panel">
                        {% include "_identities_organizations.html" %}
                    </div>

                    <!-- Users Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-users" class="sub-tab-panel">
                        {% include "_identities_users.html" %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Configuration Tab -->
        <div id="tab-configuration" class="tab-panel">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <p>Configuration settings coming soon.</p>
                <p class="hint">Future: Role/Type/Status mappings, User management, Audit logs</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<script>
    // Embed lookup tables for inline edit/add forms
    const projectTypes = {{ project_types | tojson }};
    const projectStatuses = {{ project_statuses | tojson }};

    // Main tab switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Remove active from all main tabs and panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active to clicked button and corresponding panel
            btn.classList.add('active');
            const tabName = btn.dataset.tab;
            document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');
        });
    });

    // Sub-tab switching (within Identities tab)
    document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Remove active from all sub-tabs and sub-panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active to clicked button and corresponding sub-panel
            btn.classList.add('active');
            const subName = btn.dataset.sub;
            document.getElementById(`sub-${subName}`).classList.add('active');
        });
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}

## 📄 captain_implementation_guide

# Captain's Command Center — Implementation Guide

## Overview

This document contains all code changes needed to build the Captain's tabbed page. The Captain gets a special-case route that shows three tabs: Projects, Identities, and Configuration. The Identities tab has sub-selectors for Contacts, Organizations, and Users.

**Key design decisions:**
- Captain's page defaults to Projects tab (your primary workflow)
- Projects tab has same inline edit/add as other roles
- Identities tab is a two-level interface: main sub-selector buttons + three sub-forms
- Configuration tab is a placeholder for Phase 2+
- All routing happens within `/crew?role=captain` — no new URLs

---

## File Changes Summary

| File | Action | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `src/curator/web/routes/crew.py` | Modify | Add captain detection, select captain.html template |
| `src/curator/templates/base.html` | Modify | Link tabs.css |
| `src/curator/templates/captain.html` | Create | Main tabbed layout with Projects/Identities/Configuration |
| `src/curator/templates/_identities_contacts.html` | Create | Contacts sub-form placeholder |
| `src/curator/templates/_identities_organizations.html` | Create | Organizations sub-form placeholder |
| `src/curator/templates/_identities_users.html` | Create | Users sub-form placeholder |
| `static/css/components/tabs.css` | Create | Tab styling and animations |

---

## 1. Modify `src/curator/web/routes/crew.py`

### Location

In the `crew_dashboard()` function, around line 160-190, after the HTMX handling block.

### BEFORE

```python
    # HTMX requests return only the table rows partial
    is_htmx = request.headers.get("HX-Request") == "true"

    if is_htmx:
        template = env.get_template("_crew_rows.html")
        return HTMLResponse(template.render(records=records))

    # Fetch lookup tables for dropdowns
    lookups = await _fetch_lookups(db)

    template = env.get_template("crew.html")

    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": records,
        "search": search,
        "project_types": lookups["types"],
        "project_statuses": lookups["statuses"],
    }

    return HTMLResponse(template.render(**data))
```

### AFTER

```python
    # HTMX requests return only the table rows partial
    is_htmx = request.headers.get("HX-Request") == "true"

    if is_htmx:
        template = env.get_template("_crew_rows.html")
        return HTMLResponse(template.render(records=records))

    # Fetch lookup tables for dropdowns
    lookups = await _fetch_lookups(db)

    # Captain gets a tabbed interface; other roles get the standard datasheet
    if role == "captain":
        template = env.get_template("captain.html")
    else:
        template = env.get_template("crew.html")

    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": records,
        "search": search,
        "project_types": lookups["types"],
        "project_statuses": lookups["statuses"],
    }

    return HTMLResponse(template.render(**data))
```

### What Changed

- **Added 3 lines** to detect `role == "captain"` and select appropriate template
- **Everything else stays the same** — data dict, queries, lookups all unchanged
- **Other roles unchanged** — scribe, mechanic, envoy still render crew.html

---

## 3. Create `src/curator/templates/captain.html`

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Captain's Command — Curator{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<section class="crew-section">
    <div class="crew-header">
        <img src="/static/img/captain.png" alt="Captain" class="crew-hero-image">
        <h1>{{ role_title }}</h1>
        <a href="/" class="btn-back">← Back to Crew</a>
    </div>

    <!-- Main Tab Navigation -->
    <div class="tab-bar">
        <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="projects">Projects</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="identities">Identities</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="configuration">Configuration</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Main Tab Panels -->
    <div class="tab-panels">
        <!-- Projects Tab -->
        <div id="tab-projects" class="tab-panel active">
            <div class="crew-content">
                {% if records %}
                    <table class="records-table">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th></th>
                                <th>Name</th>
                                <th>Type</th>
                                <th>Status</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="crew-rows">
                            {% for record in records %}
                            <tr class="project-row" id="display-row-{{ record['id'] }}">
                                <td class="icon-col">
                                    <button class="edit-icon" title="Edit" data-project-id="{{ record['id'] }}">✏️</button>
                                    <button class="detail-icon" title="Details" disabled>⋯</button>
                                </td>
                                <td>{{ record["name"] }}</td>
                                <td>{{ record["type"] or "—" }}</td>
                                <td>{{ record["status"] }}</td>
                            </tr>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                {% else %}
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <p>No projects found.</p>
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Identities Tab -->
        <div id="tab-identities" class="tab-panel">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <!-- Identities Sub-selector -->
                <div class="sub-tab-bar">
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn active" data-sub="contacts">Contacts</button>
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn" data-sub="organizations">Organizations</button>
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn" data-sub="users">Users (DB Auth)</button>
                </div>

                <!-- Identities Sub-panels -->
                <div class="sub-tab-panels">
                    <!-- Contacts Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-contacts" class="sub-tab-panel active">
                        {% include "_identities_contacts.html" %}
                    </div>

                    <!-- Organizations Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-organizations" class="sub-tab-panel">
                        {% include "_identities_organizations.html" %}
                    </div>

                    <!-- Users Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-users" class="sub-tab-panel">
                        {% include "_identities_users.html" %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Configuration Tab -->
        <div id="tab-configuration" class="tab-panel">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <p>Configuration settings coming soon.</p>
                <p class="hint">Future: Role/Type/Status mappings, User management, Audit logs</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<script>
    // Main tab switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Remove active from all main tabs and panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active to clicked button and corresponding panel
            btn.classList.add('active');
            const tabName = btn.dataset.tab;
            document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');
        });
    });

    // Sub-tab switching (within Identities tab)
    document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Remove active from all sub-tabs and sub-panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active to clicked button and corresponding sub-panel
            btn.classList.add('active');
            const subName = btn.dataset.sub;
            document.getElementById(`sub-${subName}`).classList.add('active');
        });
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

### Notes

- **Projects tab active by default** — first button and panel have `.active` class on load
- **Two-level tab system** — main tabs (Projects, Identities, Configuration) and sub-tabs within Identities
- **Projects table ready for inline edit/add** — same structure as crew.html, will work with existing edit/add routes
- **Sub-panels are includes** — each sub-form is a separate template file for clarity
- **Vanilla JS** — no external dependencies, minimal bundle size

### CSS Notes

- **WCYJ Teal (#0f766e)** used for active states (matches your brand)
- **Two tab levels:** Main tabs (prominent, 1rem size), sub-tabs (smaller, 0.9rem, lighter gray)

## 1. Modify `src/curator/web/routes/crew.py`

### BEFORE
```python
"""Crew role dashboard routes."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, Depends
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader
from pathlib import Path

from dbkit.connection import AsyncDBConnection
from curator.config import ConfigManager
from curator.web.deps import get_config, get_db

router = APIRouter()

# Initialize Jinja2 for crew dashboard
TEMPLATES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "templates"
env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(TEMPLATES_DIR))


@router.get("/crew", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def crew_dashboard(
    role: str = Query("captain"),
    config: ConfigManager = Depends(get_config),
    db: AsyncDBConnection = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Crew dashboard — displays projects filtered by crew role.

    Query parameters:
        role: One of the roles defined in curator.yaml

    Queries the role-specific PostgreSQL view (e.g. projects.scribe_view)
    and passes results to the crew.html template.
    """
    crew_roles = config.get("crew", "roles")
    valid_roles = [r["name"] for r in crew_roles]

    if role not in valid_roles:
        role = "captain"  # Safe fallback

    # Find the role's metadata
    role_meta = next((r for r in crew_roles if r["name"] == role), None)

    # Query the role-specific view — role is validated above, safe to interpolate
    view_name = f"projects.{role}_view"
    sql = f"""
        SELECT
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.slug,
            p.description,
            ps.name  AS status,
            pt.name  AS type
        FROM {view_name} p
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_status ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_type   pt ON pt.id = p.type_id
        ORDER BY p.name
    """
    records = await db.fetch_all(sql)

    template = env.get_template("crew.html")

    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": records,
    }

    return template.render(**data)
```

### AFTER
```python
"""Crew role dashboard routes."""

from fastapi import APIRouter, Query, Depends
from fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse
from jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader
from pathlib import Path

from dbkit.connection import AsyncDBConnection
from curator.config import ConfigManager
from curator.web.deps import get_config, get_db

router = APIRouter()

# Initialize Jinja2 for crew dashboard
TEMPLATES_DIR = Path(__file__).parent.parent.parent / "templates"
env = Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(TEMPLATES_DIR))


@router.get("/crew", response_class=HTMLResponse)
async def crew_dashboard(
    role: str = Query("captain"),
    config: ConfigManager = Depends(get_config),
    db: AsyncDBConnection = Depends(get_db),
):
    """Crew dashboard — displays projects filtered by crew role.

    Query parameters:
        role: One of the roles defined in curator.yaml

    For captain, renders a tabbed interface with Projects, Identities, and
    Configuration tabs. For other roles, renders the standard crew datasheet.

    Queries the role-specific PostgreSQL view (e.g. projects.scribe_view)
    and passes results to the appropriate template.
    """
    crew_roles = config.get("crew", "roles")
    valid_roles = [r["name"] for r in crew_roles]

    if role not in valid_roles:
        role = "captain"  # Safe fallback

    # Find the role's metadata
    role_meta = next((r for r in crew_roles if r["name"] == role), None)

    # Query the role-specific view — role is validated above, safe to interpolate
    view_name = f"projects.{role}_view"
    sql = f"""
        SELECT
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.slug,
            p.description,
            ps.name  AS status,
            pt.name  AS type
        FROM {view_name} p
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_status ps ON ps.id = p.status_id
        LEFT JOIN projects.project_type   pt ON pt.id = p.type_id
        ORDER BY p.name
    """
    records = await db.fetch_all(sql)

    # Captain gets a tabbed interface; other roles get the standard datasheet
    if role == "captain":
        template = env.get_template("captain.html")
    else:
        template = env.get_template("crew.html")

    data = {
        "role": role,
        "role_title": role_meta["title"] if role_meta else role.title(),
        "theme": config.get("ui", "theme"),
        "records": records,
    }

    return template.render(**data)
```

### Changes Explained

- **Added captain detection:** `if role == "captain"` branch selects `captain.html` template
- **Updated docstring:** Mentions that captain gets a tabbed interface
- **No changes to query logic:** Captain still uses `projects.captain_view` which returns all projects
- **Data passed to template:** Same `records` list works for both `crew.html` and `captain.html`

## 2. Create `templates/captain.html`

```html
{% extends "base.html" %}

{% block title %}Captain's Command — Curator{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<section class="crew-section">
    <div class="crew-header">
        <img src="/static/img/captain.png" alt="Captain" class="crew-hero-image">
        <h1>{{ role_title }}</h1>
        <a href="/" class="btn-back">← Back to Crew</a>
    </div>

    <!-- Main Tab Navigation -->
    <div class="tab-bar">
        <button class="tab-btn active" data-tab="projects">Projects</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="identities">Identities</button>
        <button class="tab-btn" data-tab="configuration">Configuration</button>
    </div>

    <!-- Main Tab Panels -->
    <div class="tab-panels">
        <!-- Projects Tab -->
        <div id="tab-projects" class="tab-panel active">
            <div class="crew-content">
                {% if records %}
                    <table class="records-table">
                        <thead>
                            <tr>
                                <th></th>
                                <th>Name</th>
                                <th>Type</th>
                                <th>Status</th>
                            </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody id="crew-rows">
                            {% for record in records %}
                            <tr class="project-row" id="display-row-{{ record['id'] }}">
                                <td class="icon-col">
                                    <button class="edit-icon" title="Edit" data-project-id="{{ record['id'] }}">✏️</button>
                                    <button class="detail-icon" title="Details" disabled>⋯</button>
                                </td>
                                <td>{{ record["name"] }}</td>
                                <td>{{ record["type"] or "—" }}</td>
                                <td>{{ record["status"] }}</td>
                            </tr>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </tbody>
                    </table>
                {% else %}
                    <div class="empty-state">
                        <p>No projects found.</p>
                    </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Identities Tab -->
        <div id="tab-identities" class="tab-panel">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <!-- Identities Sub-selector -->
                <div class="sub-tab-bar">
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn active" data-sub="contacts">Contacts</button>
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn" data-sub="organizations">Organizations</button>
                    <button class="sub-tab-btn" data-sub="users">Users (DB Auth)</button>
                </div>

                <!-- Identities Sub-panels -->
                <div class="sub-tab-panels">
                    <!-- Contacts Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-contacts" class="sub-tab-panel active">
                        {% include "_identities_contacts.html" %}
                    </div>

                    <!-- Organizations Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-organizations" class="sub-tab-panel">
                        {% include "_identities_organizations.html" %}
                    </div>

                    <!-- Users Sub-form -->
                    <div id="sub-users" class="sub-tab-panel">
                        {% include "_identities_users.html" %}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Configuration Tab -->
        <div id="tab-configuration" class="tab-panel">
            <div class="crew-content">
                <p>Configuration settings coming soon.</p>
                <p class="hint">Future: Role/Type/Status mappings, User management, Audit logs</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</section>

<script>
    // Main tab switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Remove active from all main tabs and panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active to clicked button and corresponding panel
            btn.classList.add('active');
            const tabName = btn.dataset.tab;
            document.getElementById(`tab-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');
        });
    });

    // Sub-tab switching (within Identities tab)
    document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Remove active from all sub-tabs and sub-panels
            document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.sub-tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active to clicked button and corresponding sub-panel
            btn.classList.add('active');
            const subName = btn.dataset.sub;
            document.getElementById(`sub-${subName}`).classList.add('active');
        });
    });
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

### Notes

- **Two-level tab system:** Main tabs (Projects, Identities, Configuration) and sub-tabs within Identities
- **Projects tab reuses table structure:** Ready for inline edit/add (next session)
- **Sub-panels are includes:** Each sub-form is a separate template file for clarity
- **Inline JS:** Tab switching is vanilla JS with no external dependencies
- **Projects tab active by default:** First `.tab-btn` and first `.tab-panel` have `.active` class on load
